title: Stable registry-slot handle repair
problem: Warm changed-authority binds still deep-copy immutable adaptive support arrays from the run-lifetime registry into provider-owned storage.

repair.warm_exact_key_hit: provider stores slot handle; no adaptive table deep assignment
repair.evaluation: provider reads the bracketing immutable support values through a registry slot sampling method
repair.cache_miss: existing build path remains; newly cached entries may subsequently bind by stable slot
repair.full_registry_miss: existing valid caller-owned uncached table fallback remains

performance_gates.changed_authority_64_key_switching: median repaired/baseline bind ratio <= 0.80 versus F-AHL36
performance_gates.same_key_bind: no more than 10% slower than F-AHL36 same-key reference
performance_gates.provider_evaluate: no more than 5% slower than equivalent provider-owned-table evaluation on warm represented-domain calls
